limitations: The strictness established is conditional and applies only to the complete SER channel; it provides no new receiver gain, native delivery, or stronger accessible receiver channel after tracing the bath.
The construction does not yield an operational separation for the original owner, nor does it justify bath access.
The result does not classify all conserving realizations, establish a universally weakest assumption, or prove the necessity of coherence for every possible separation.
No native operation, physical conservation law, detector, empirical signal, time coordinate, or stage certificate is derived.
Hilbert factorization, normalized encoding, exact all-input channel C, product preparation, and same-owner effect access remain SUPPLIED premises.
The physical interpretation of pi_u, Q_E, and F_R as charge, as well as spectral exclusion and endpoint-statistics conservation, remain NEW mathematical assumptions.
next_native_obligation: Produce one chain with all three links: (1) an actual event identified with a named inherited operation, (2) that operation changes a state, action, or available effect on an independently identified retained owner, and (3) one fixed, owner-available effect has a source-dependent response.
proof_checks: Verified the properties of the qutrit bath state tau: The trace is (2+2+2)/6 = 1. The eigenvalues of the block-diagonal matrix are 1/2, 1/3, and 1/6, confirming it is strictly positive, full rank, and coherent between e_0 and e_2.

Verified the all-sixteen-unit channel identity: The unitary U = W_R V acts as the isometry J on the SR subsystems and maps tau to tau' on E. Tracing out E and R correctly yields the exact source map C(rho) = Q rho Q + rho_uu pi_p and the receiver effect q(rho) = rho_uu for all inputs, including coherences.

Verified the complete statistics preservation: Both tau and tau' have an identical uniform diagonal (1/3, 1/3, 1/3) in the Q_E eigenbasis. Since W_R commutes with pi_u + F_R, the total charge K distribution is exactly conserved for every source rho.

Verified the full-rank support and invariance no-go proof: For source o, the target output is pi_o tensor tau' tensor pi_{0,R}. Because tau and tau' are full rank on E, the support L_o is exactly |o> tensor H_E tensor |0_R>. Any unitary Z achieving this density-operator equality must satisfy Z(L_o) = L_o.

Verified the degeneracy objection resolution: Global degeneracies in K cannot evade the proof because the exact density-matrix equality on the fixed mixed preparation forces Z to preserve L_o *before* the commutator restriction is applied. Restricted to L_o, K is exactly Q_E, which is non-degenerate (0, 2, 4).

Verified the phase contradiction: A unitary B on E commuting with Q_E must be diagonal in the {e_0, e_2, e_4} basis. Conjugation by any such diagonal B cannot change the zero e_0-e_4 coherence in tau to the required 1/6 coherence in tau', proving nonexistence of a globally commuting Z for the complete channel.

Verified the E-traced SR equivalence and dephased control: Tracing E yields the exact same SR channel as the globally conserving W_R tensor I_E. Furthermore, replacing tau with the dephased state I_E/3 makes V fix the bath, rendering the complete SER outputs identical to those of W_R tensor I_E. This confirms the obstruction is strictly isolated to the unaccessed coherent bath.
